note: Ground truth for the anti-circular gate. Weights follow measurement quality: xing-* are least-squares line crossings (1.5); cnr-* are block corners (1.0); hyd-* are hydrant DISCS, hand-placed symbols carrying ~+-25 px of drafting slop (0.5). hyd-22nd-avA-on01 is weight 0 and schematic: sheet 01's top-edge 22nd St pipework is drawn 60-90 px out of place against block corners on its own sheet - decoration, not survey. NOTE: unlike 1899, the 1889 wharf sheets' block outlines are NOT schematic; they agree with the downtown sheets to a smooth affine.
